title: A scheme covered by affine basic opens of sections generating the unit ideal is affine
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f_1,\dots,f_m\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ such that the ideal they generate in $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is the unit ideal and each open $X_{f_i}=\{x: f_i(x)\neq0\}$ is affine. Then $X$ is affine.
